title: Ordering Drinks at a Bar
meta: B2 · 约 270 词 · 场景：酒吧点酒、开账与核对账单

lines.en: Hey, what can I get you?
lines.zh: 嗨，要喝点什么？

lines.en: **Hi. What's on happy hour right now?**
lines.zh: 你好。现在欢乐时光有什么优惠？

lines.en: Until eight, house wines and draft beers are ==one-for-one==, and selected cocktails are twelve dollars.
lines.zh: 八点之前，自家酒和生啤买一送一，指定鸡尾酒十二块。

lines.en: Nice. I'm not much of a beer person, though. What would you recommend __if I like__ something not too sweet?
lines.zh: 不错。不过我不太喝啤酒。如果我喜欢不太甜的，你推荐什么？

lines.en: Try our gin and tonic with ==yuzu==. It's ==crisp== and a little bitter. Most people love it.
lines.zh: 试试我们的柚子金汤力，清爽、带点苦味。大多数人都很喜欢。

lines.en: I'll __go for__ that. And for my friend, anything ==non-alcoholic==? He's driving.
lines.zh: 那我就要这个。给我朋友有没有不含酒精的？他要开车。

lines.en: We do a great ginger and lime ==mocktail==. Very refreshing.
lines.zh: 我们有一款很棒的姜汁青柠无酒精鸡尾酒，很清爽。

lines.en: **Perfect, one of each. Can I start a tab? A few more colleagues are coming.**
lines.zh: 好，各来一杯。我能开个账先挂着吗？还有几个同事要来。

lines.en: Sure. I'll just need to hold a card behind the bar.
lines.zh: 可以。我需要押一张卡在吧台。

lines.en: Here you go. Could you also __bring a jug of water__ to our table? We're the ones by the window.
lines.zh: 给你。能再送一壶水到我们桌吗？我们坐在窗边。

lines.en: You got it. I'll bring the drinks over.
lines.zh: 没问题。饮料我给你们送过去。

lines.en: **Hi, we're heading off soon. Could I close out the tab, please?**
lines.zh: 你好，我们要走了。能帮我结一下账吗？

lines.en: Sure. That comes to two hundred and eighteen dollars.
lines.zh: 好的。一共两百一十八块。

lines.en: Hmm, that seems a bit high. Could I __take a look at__ the bill before I pay?
lines.zh: 嗯，好像有点多。付钱之前能让我看一下账单吗？

lines.en: Of course, here you go.
lines.zh: 当然，给你。

lines.en: I think the ==last round== was charged at full price. We ordered it at seven forty-five, still within ==happy hour==.
lines.zh: 最后一轮好像是按原价收的。我们七点四十五点的，还在欢乐时光内。

lines.en: Let me check the system. Oh, you're right. It was ==keyed in== at eight oh five. Sorry, I'll ==adjust== that.
lines.zh: 我查一下系统。哦，你说得对。是八点零五才录进去的。抱歉，我改一下。

lines.en: Thanks. And we didn't order these nachos. I think they're from the next table.
lines.zh: 谢谢。还有，这份玉米片不是我们点的，应该是隔壁桌的。

lines.en: My bad. I'll take those off too. The new total is one hundred and seventy-six.
lines.zh: 是我搞错了，这个也去掉。新的总数是一百七十六。

lines.en: That looks right now. __Thanks for sorting it out__.
lines.zh: 现在对了。谢谢你处理好。

lines.en: No problem. Don't forget your card. Have a good night, guys!
lines.zh: 不客气。别忘了你的卡。祝你们晚上愉快！

gist.a: 八点前自家酒和生啤买一送一，指定鸡尾酒十二块。

gist.q: 「你」给自己和朋友各点了什么？为什么？
gist.a: 自己要了不太甜的柚子金汤力；朋友要开车，所以点了姜汁青柠无酒精鸡尾酒。

gist.q: 结账时发现了哪两个问题？
gist.a: 最后一轮是七点四十五点的，却因为八点零五才录入被按原价收；还多算了一份隔壁桌的玉米片。总数从两百一十八改成一百七十六。

prompts.q: 你请客户喝酒，但你不确定他喝不喝酒。跟调酒师说你们的需求，问几个不同口味的选择，并说明全部记在你的账上。
prompts.ref: Hi, I'm hosting a client tonight, and I'm not sure what he likes yet. Could you suggest a couple of options? Maybe one light cocktail, one good whisky, and something non-alcoholic in case he doesn't drink. Whatever we order tonight, please put it all on my tab. Here's my card.
prompts.ref_zh: 你好，我今晚招待一位客户，还不清楚他喜欢喝什么。能推荐几个选择吗？比如一款清淡的鸡尾酒、一款好的威士忌，再来一款无酒精的，以防他不喝酒。今晚点的全都记在我的账上。这是我的卡。

prompts.q: 你点了一杯鸡尾酒，喝了一口发现太甜，跟你说的口味完全不一样。礼貌地跟调酒师说明，问能不能调整或换一杯。
prompts.ref: Sorry, could I ask you something? I had a sip of this, and it's a lot sweeter than I expected. I'm not a fan of sweet drinks. Is there any way to make it a bit drier, maybe with more lime or soda? If not, I'm happy to switch to a gin and tonic instead.
prompts.ref_zh: 不好意思，想问一下。我尝了一口，比我想的甜很多。我不太喜欢甜的。能不能调干一点，比如多加点青柠或者苏打水？不行的话，我换一杯金汤力也可以。

words.ex: Bubble tea is one-for-one on Wednesdays.
